name: daily-sales-followups
prompt: Walk business/sops/sales/follow-up-cadence.md. Pull all rows from the Notion 'Pipeline' database, identify which prospects have a follow-up due today based on the cadence table, and draft each follow-up. Reference the original demo notes or prior emails — no generic 'just checking in'. Every email is a DRAFT to #sales per the approval-gate SOP. Also scan Gmail for any inbound leads that arrived overnight and process them per business/sops/sales/inbound-lead.md.
